company.description: Caseflood.ai is an AI-powered platform for law firms that automates administrative, operational, and client communication tasks, effectively working as a virtual receptionist, intake specialist, and case coordinator. Its primary purpose is to replace or reduce the need for human administrative staff in legal practices by using advanced AI agents that manage client intake, case updates, and ongoing client management around the clock.
